requirements.title: Argument keywords for nonintrinsic explicit-interface procedures have host or declaration scoping-unit scope
requirements.definition: As an argument keyword, a dummy argument name in an internal procedure, module procedure, or interface body has the host scoping-unit scope; a dummy argument of a procedure declaration statement with explicit interface has the containing scoping-unit scope.
requirements.oracle:
Source accounting only. Future executable fixtures must establish a positive nondefault state first, use sentinels distinct from every value the exercised construct can write, and observe only portable name-resolution, scope, type, value, or source-admission properties. No diagnostic is claimed for an unnumbered program restriction. Diagnostic wording, processor-created external names, addresses, storage layout, image/team execution, and compiler agreement are not oracles.

S19.3.5-001 scoping/name-association runtime fixtures: one complete run/effect/f2023 program calls an internal procedure, an external procedure with an interface body, and a procedure pointer declared with an explicit abstract interface by their dummy argument keywords. Same-spelling host sentinels keep distinct negative values, while each procedure writes a distinct exact integer result. Positional-call mutants use the host sentinel actuals instead of keyword literals and therefore expose any loss of keyword scoping.

requirements.title: Argument keywords appear only in references for their procedure and follow use or host accessibility
requirements.definition: As an argument keyword, a dummy argument name may appear only in a procedure reference for its procedure; argument keywords are accessible for references to that procedure in scoping units that access the procedure by use or host association.

requirements.title: Intrinsic procedure dummy argument names are scoped as keywords at the reference site
requirements.definition: A dummy argument name in an intrinsic procedure has scope as an argument keyword of the scoping unit containing the procedure reference and may appear only in a reference for that intrinsic procedure.

pending.intrinsic-keyword-own-procedure-only: Source-control plan uses an intrinsic keyword with the wrong intrinsic and a one-token control selecting the matching intrinsic; no mandatory diagnostic is claimed here absent a numbered owner.
